gaps.title: Conformity Assessment for Changes in AI Systems
gaps.description: The UAE texts do not address the need for a new conformity assessment when changes occur in AI systems, which is required by international benchmarks.

benchmark_citations_verified.quote: whenever a change occurs which may affect the compliance of a high-risk AI system with this Regulation (e.g. change of operating system or software architecture), or when the intended purpose of the system changes, that AI system should be considered to be a new AI system which should undergo a new conformity assessment.
